title: Observation Assimilation Transformer: Probabilistic Weather Analysis from Sparse Station Observations
abstract: arXiv:2610.28327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present the Observation Assimilation Transformer (OAT), a geometry-aware neural process that corrects and refines a prior numerical weather prediction (NWP) field into a high-resolution posterior field by assimilating sparse observations. OAT is an encoder-decoder transformer that considers a set of observed locations and their NWP prior to condition predictions at a set of arbitrary unobserved query locations. Its sparse attention mechanism makes it scalable to thousands of station observations and depends on relative positions between locations, never on the absolute coordinates. The model allows for partially missing observations, predictions at arbitrary continuous locations without grid projection, and outputs are parametric distributions. A station-randomized training algorithm is developed with continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) loss. We test OAT on two datasets - one at regional scale with hundreds of stations, and one

translated_title: 观测同化Transformer：基于稀疏站点观测的概率性天气分析
translated_abstract: 我们提出了观测同化Transformer（OAT），这是一种几何感知的神经过程，通过同化稀疏观测，将先验的数值天气预报（NWP）场修正并精化为高分辨率的后验场。OAT是一个编码器-解码器Transformer，它以一组观测位置及其NWP先验为条件，在任意未观测的查询位置集合上进行预测。其稀疏注意力机制使其可扩展至数千个站点观测，且仅依赖于位置之间的相对位置，而从不依赖绝对坐标。该模型允许部分缺失的观测，可在任意连续位置进行预测而无需网格投影，并且输出为参数化分布。我们开发了一种基于连续排序概率评分（CRPS）损失的站点随机化训练算法。我们在两个数据集上测试了OAT——一个是包含数百个站点的区域尺度数据集，另一个是……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出观测同化Transformer（OAT），一种几何感知的神经过程模型，利用稀疏注意力机制同化稀疏站点观测，将数值天气预报先验场修正为高分辨率的概率性后验场，可扩展至数千站点并支持任意连续位置的预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Observation Assimilation Transformer (OAT), a geometry-aware neural process using sparse attention to assimilate sparse station observations, refining NWP prior fields into high-resolution probabilistic posterior fields scalable to thousands of stations with predictions at arbitrary continuous locations.
